policy: Independent L2 triage only. Model assessments do not mutate scanner candidate status, do not establish safety or confirmed vulnerability, and do not support precision/recall.

reviews.narrow_claim: Potential missing authorization on DBINDER_ADD_COMMAUTH auth-information exchange; unresolved.

evidence_facts.fact: ProcessProto rejects negative UID/PID, resolves session name, then calls ProcessData.
ProcessData serializes pid/uid/device/stub/token identity fields and sends DBINDER_ADD_COMMAUTH.
Receiver dispatcher routes DBINDER_ADD_COMMAUTH to a handler that rejects local IPC and caller UID >= ALLOWED_UID before AddAuthInfo.
AddAuthInfo reads remote identity fields from the parcel and may attach AppAuthInfo to process state.

reviews.counterevidence: A receiver-side transport caller UID gate exists; this is not simply an unguarded local SendRequest.
unknowns: Provenance and trust semantics of DBinderDatabusInvoker::GetCallerUid().
Whether gated transport identity is bound to parcel-supplied remoteUid/PID/token/device ID.
Whether AddAuthInfo attachment grants a capability or is safe for admitted principals.
Product configuration/reachability, attacker privilege, trigger and concrete impact.
reviews.confidence: Moderate on source path and receiver gate; insufficient on security outcome.
next_evidence: Trace GetCallerUid population and its binding to AddAuthInfo tuple.
Verify product build/configuration and actual GET_PROTO_INFO reachability.
Establish effect of forged or accepted auth records.
reviews.status_effect: No scanner status change; remains a static candidate for more evidence.

reviews.narrow_claim: The specific claim that DBinderDumpTransaction has no caller authorization is contradicted by an explicit local-caller and UID allowlist guard in this pinned source. This does not prove the policy is adequate or the product safe.

evidence_facts.fact: Only local callers with UID 0, SHELL_UID or HIDUMPER_SERVICE_UID reach OnRemoteDump; other paths return.
OnRemoteDump reads an FD and args, invokes Dump, and closes the FD.
Base IPCObjectStub::Dump logs metadata and returns ERR_NONE; subclasses may override.
Supporting local/remote semantics: GetCallingUid is unavailable for non-local calls; Binder invoker is local and DBinder invoker is not.
Proxy Dump serializes caller FD and args and sends DUMP_TRANSACTION.

reviews.counterevidence: The guard blocks DBinder callers and admits only local UID 0/2000/1212.
unknowns: Whether those principals are appropriately trusted under the product threat model and SELinux policy.
Specific product service registration, concrete Dump override, and sensitive output.
Whether an untrusted app can influence or induce an allowlisted principal to make this call.
Deployment-specific transport/build and real product reachability.
reviews.confidence: High on the explicit source guard and narrow claim refutation; low on product policy/impact.
next_evidence: Pin target product configuration and deployed transports.
Bind a specific service registration and Dump override.
Verify actual UID principals, permissions and allowed dump-data policy.
reviews.status_effect: No scanner status change; model triage cannot upgrade/downgrade finding lifecycle.
